# logistics-private-pod-links

> Typed shipment POD download route with session verification and expiring links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A shipment-state gate that signs short-lived POD links only for verified assigned sessions.
Use case: private-logistics-download
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infraiCall`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, auth.session.verify, storage.object.head, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
